hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Stay clear of the coil path, the gooseneck, and flowback iron under flow.

name: Coiled tubing (through the stack)
function: The length of coiled tubing shown running from the reel over the gooseneck, down through the injector, stripper, and BOP into the well.

tabs.overview: Continuous welded steel pipe in sizes such as 2, 2-3/8, and 2-7/8 in.; wall thickness tapered along the string on long reels; fatigue life tracked per foot in the string management software.
tabs.engineering: Yield strength grades in the 80,000 to 130,000 psi class; wall 0.156 to 0.204 in. typical.
tabs.safety: Fatigue cracks at the gooseneck bend and at the reel are the common string failure; the string is retired on a cycle count.
tabs.evidence: Public coiled tubing pressure control guide (S24), API RP 16ST and API RP 5C7 scope (S23, S26), field practice (S9).

standards.paraphrase: Coiled tubing string management and running practices.
